[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1841. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1780|James Glasgow]].

Margaret Jane, infant daughter of Rev. James Glasgow, missionary to Kattywar for the Presbyterian Church in Ireland, died at Rajkote, East Indies, on 11 June 1841, aged two months and 26 days.<ref>Belfast News-Letter, 10 September 1841, p.2, Margaret Jane Glasgow death notice; [https://www.newspapers.com/image/390562197/ record].</ref> Strong matching name, father, place and date support [[Glasgow-2898]] and her father [[Glasgow-1780]]. The notice does not name her mother or birthplace.
